card.name: Last noun of a short phrase
card.fires_on: The noun that ends a stock prepositional phrase such as "on these occasions", "under these circumstances", "in the morning" or "on the inside". It sits just before a period or comma.

modes.label: After these/rare
modes.description: Noun like occasions or circumstances after "these" or "rare".
modes.example: Penicillamine dosage should not be increased under these<< circumstances>>.

modes.label: Place or time noun
modes.description: Noun such as morning, inside, side or there that completes a location or time phrase.
modes.example: Your eye may be teary or gunky, especially when you wake up in the<< morning>>.

modes.label: Idiom ending
modes.description: Final word of a set phrase like "put it to good use" or "from there".

card.plain: It fires on the last word of a small fixed phrase about time, place or circumstance, just before the phrase ends.
